profile.description: A profile Handle, such as ``profile_7f3a9c2e``. Its frame is split.

anyOf.description: One shuffled train/test split.

test_size.description: Share of rows held out as ``test``. Null means 0.2. Constraints: greater than 0; less than 1.

stratify.description: True keeps each target class's share the same in train and test. Null stratifies when the profile declares a target.

target.description: The declared target to stratify on. Null takes the profile's target; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: One chronological split: the latest rows are ``test``, so no future row trains.

time_column.description: The datetime or numeric column that orders the rows. Its sentinels count as missing, and rows with no time go to train.

test_size.description: Share of rows, the latest ones, held out as ``test``. Null means 0.2 unless ``cutoff`` is set; set at most one of the two. Constraints: greater than 0; less than 1.

cutoff.description: Rows at or after this time are ``test``. A datetime for a datetime column (an ISO string on the CLI), a number for a numeric one. Null splits by ``test_size``. Constraints: in date-time format.

anyOf.description: One train/test split that keeps every group whole on one side.

group_column.description: The column naming each row's group, such as a customer id. Rows missing it form one group.

test_size.description: Share of groups held out as ``test``. Null means 0.2. Constraints: greater than 0; less than 1.

anyOf.description: ``k`` shuffled folds: each row is in exactly one fold's validation frame.

k.description: Number of folds. Null means 5. Constraints: at least 2; at most 100.

stratify.description: True keeps each target class's share the same in every fold. Null stratifies when the profile declares a target.

target.description: The declared target to stratify on. Null takes the profile's target; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: ``k`` folds that keep every group whole on one side of each fold.

group_column.description: The column naming each row's group. Rows missing it form one group.

k.description: Number of folds, at most the number of groups. Null means 5. Constraints: at least 2; at most 100.

stratify.description: True balances target classes across folds as far as whole groups allow. Null stratifies when the profile declares a target.

target.description: The declared target to stratify on. Null takes the profile's target; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: k-fold run ``repeats`` times, each with a new shuffle: ``k * repeats`` folds.

k.description: Number of folds per repeat. Null means 5. Constraints: at least 2; at most 100.

repeats.description: Number of repeats. ``k * repeats`` may be at most 100. Null means 10. Constraints: at least 1; at most 50.

stratify.description: True keeps each target class's share the same in every fold. Null stratifies when the profile declares a target.

target.description: The declared target to stratify on. Null takes the profile's target; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: A held-out ``test`` frame, then ``k`` folds over the remaining rows.

test_size.description: Share of rows held out as ``test``. Null means 0.2. Constraints: greater than 0; less than 1.

k.description: Number of folds over the rest. Null means 5. Constraints: at least 2; at most 100.

stratify.description: True stratifies the hold-out and the folds on the target. Null stratifies when the profile declares a target.

target.description: The declared target to stratify on. Null takes the profile's target; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: One train/test split balanced on every signal the profile flags: target, missingness, extremes, rare labels.

test_size.description: Share of rows held out as ``test``. It also sets the viability floor, ``ceil(2 / min(test_size, 1 - test_size))`` rows. Null means 0.2. Constraints: greater than 0; less than 1.

target.description: The declared target to balance with the other signals. Null takes the profile's target, if any; name one when it declares several.

anyOf.description: ``k`` folds balanced on every signal the profile flags.

k.description: Number of folds. It is also the viability floor, in rows. Null means 5. Constraints: at least 2; at most 100.

target.description: The declared target to balance with the other signals. Null takes the profile's target, if any; name one when it declares several.

scheme.description: How to split, chosen by ``kind``; null means ``profile_stratified`` with its defaults.

seed.description: Seed of every shuffle. Null means a fixed default, so the same call gives the same split. Constraints: at least 0; at most 4294967295.

anyOf.description: Every split dial, grouped. Null keeps every default.
Dials the profile-stratified schemes read. Null keeps every default in this group.

max_stratification_signals.description: Most signals balanced at once. The cap is the smaller of this and ``n_rows / rows_per_signal``. Null means 50. Constraints: at least 1.

rows_per_signal.description: Rows the data must have per balanced signal. Null means 10. Constraints: at least 1.

boolean_minority_threshold.description: A boolean column whose rarer value is below this share becomes a signal. Null means 0.05. Constraints: at most 0.5; greater than 0.

redundancy_correlation_threshold.description: Absolute correlation at or above which two signals count as one, and the less important is dropped. Null means 0.95. Constraints: at most 1; greater than 0.

stratification.description: The signal gates of the profile-stratified schemes.

thresholds.description: Dials of the profile-stratified schemes, each with its default and range. Null keeps every default.

output.description: The test frame and the folds, each a frame Handle carrying the profile's declarations.

warnings.description: Caveats on this result, most actionable first. Empty when there are none.

fields.description: Always exactly `code`, `message`, `columns`, `param`, `hint`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: A caveat on a successful result: it worked, but read this first. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `code`: The warning's Error Code. Branch on this, not on ``message``.
Position 1, `message`: What happened and what to do, in one or two sentences.
Position 2, `columns`: Columns the warning concerns, or null.
Position 3, `param`: The argument the warning concerns, or null.
Position 4, `hint`: Library-written advice, or null.

omitted.description: One entry per list that was cut, naming the Operation that returns the rest. Empty when nothing was cut.

fields.description: Always exactly `field`, `shown`, `total`, `operation`, `reason`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: Something left out of a result: a capped list was cut, or a Literal Field withheld. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `field`: Name of the list field that was cut, or the path of the Literal Field withheld, such as ``top_values[].value``.
Position 1, `shown`: How many items the list holds; 0 for a withheld Literal Field or cut cells.
Position 2, `total`: How many items exist; for a withheld Literal Field, how many values at that path are null; for cut cells, how many were cut.
Position 3, `operation`: The Operation that returns the rest, or null when no Operation does.
Position 4, `reason`: ``cap`` when a list was cut to its cap; ``literal_policy`` when the Operator's Literal Policy is ``deny``; ``truncated`` when long text cells were cut to their character cap.

profile.description: The profile Handle that was split.

frame.description: The frame Handle the profile was made from, whose rows were split.

seed.description: The seed used: yours, or the fixed default when you passed null.

stratified_on.description: The target the split balanced; null when it balanced none.

test.description: The frame Handle of the held-out rows; null for the k-fold schemes, which hold none out.

test_rows.description: Rows in ``test``; null when it is null.

folds.description: Every fold, in repeat then index order. At most 100.

fields.description: Always exactly `index`, `repeat`, `train`, `validation`, `train_rows`, `validation_rows`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: One fold's frames. A single train/test split has one fold with no validation frame. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `index`: Fold number, from 0, within its repeat.
Position 1, `repeat`: Repeat number, from 0. Always 0 except for ``repeated_kfold``.
Position 2, `train`: The frame Handle of the training rows.
Position 3, `validation`: The frame Handle of the validation rows; null for a single train/test split, whose held-out rows are ``test``.
Position 4, `train_rows`: Rows in ``train``.
Position 5, `validation_rows`: Rows in ``validation``; null when it is null.
How many signals each gate of a profile-stratified scheme kept. Counts only.

floor.description: The viability floor: fewest rows on each side a signal or label needs.

viable.description: Signals at or above the floor on both sides.

non_redundant.description: Viable signals left after near-duplicates were dropped.

kept.description: Signals balanced. 0 means the rows were split at random.

rows_to_train.description: Rows sent to train because their target class or rare value is below the floor.

labels_to_train.description: Target classes and rare values below the floor.

stratification.description: Signal counts for the profile-stratified schemes; null for the others.

fallbacks.description: Every fallback taken, each with the dials behind it. Empty when none.

fields.description: Always exactly `fallback`, `count`, `dials`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: A step the split took because a threshold ruled out the planned one. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `fallback`: ``unstratified``: no signal could be balanced, so rows were split at random. ``signals_capped``: some signals were not balanced. ``rows_to_train``: rows of labels below the floor all went to train.
Position 1, `count`: Rows split at random, signals left out, or rows sent to train, by ``fallback``.
Position 2, `dials`: The dials or ``scheme`` arguments that decided it, with their resolved values. Empty when the data had nothing to balance.

fields.description: Always exactly `operation`, `dial`, `value`, `source`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: The dial whose value decided a threshold outcome. Turn it to change the outcome. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `operation`: The Operation that takes the dial.
Position 1, `dial`: The dial's argument path, such as ``thresholds.missingness.high_null_ratio``.
Position 2, `value`: The dial's resolved value.
Position 3, `source`: ``default`` when the library default decided, ``argument`` when the caller set it.
